last.verdict: Cloudflare's growth sped up to 39%, its fastest in nearly four years, and its Q4 forecast came in far above expectations.

takeaways.label: Growth accelerating
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 39% to $782.5M, up from 36% last quarter. Contracted future revenue due within a year (current RPO) grew 37%, so the pace looks durable.

takeaways.label: Big guidance jump
takeaways.text: Q4 revenue is guided to $845–846M versus about $798M expected. Full-year revenue guidance rose to $2.963–2.964B from $2.864–2.870B in August.

takeaways.label: Profit up, margins mixed
takeaways.text: Operating margin (excluding stock pay) rose to 17.5% from 15.3%, but gross margin slipped to 72.4% from 75.3%. Heavier spending on its network likely contributes.

takeaways.label: Cash conversion slipped
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was 10% of revenue versus 13% a year ago as equipment spending rose. A GAAP loss of $34.1M persists, driven by $174M of stock-based pay.

history.verdict: Accelerating growth and a raised full-year outlook won buyers, though much of the after-hours pop faded.

reasons.label: Growth sped up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 36% from a year earlier, up from 34% last quarter, beating expectations.

reasons.label: Margins and one-time costs
reasons.text: Gross margin fell to 73.1% from 76.3%; a $150.7M restructuring charge weighed on results.
